en: <CLT=cltMIND>With shaky hands, I pressed the doorbell...

No answer.
Did he already leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>In that case, he must be at
the dining hall. I'll try there.
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>They really are everywhere...
They want us to know we're under their control.

<CLT=cltMIND>But it doesn't have any surveillance
equipment to spy on us.

<CLT=cltMIND>This isn't Kaito's room!
Come on, calm down, get a hold of yourself...

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito doesn't seem to be in his room.
I should try going to the dining hall!
